title: Which work comes next is priority: the architect recommends it
situation: With the operator's priority set, the operator asks which of two candidate improvements comes next; the architect's guards treated choosing as a decision it owns and must record, then judged the recorded decision's consequences as a second action.
decision: (1) What comes next is priority, which the operator decides and the architect recommends (0086). Applying a priority the operator stated, the architect leads with one recommendation and the facts and reasons for it: that is neither a hand-back nor an unrecorded decision, and nothing is recorded. The hand-back and holding-open tells concern only decisions the architect owns: meaning, constraints on realization and check rulings. (2) A recorded decision's consequences are part of the record, not an action of the reply; only what the reply itself directs counts as a topic's action under 0097.
consequences: The guards distinguish a recommendation on priority from a decision the architect owns.
